dataset: Observed-only ADS-B ground-speed flight mileage benchmarks for the Gleason flat-disk map

source.attribution: Contains data from the adsb.lol open ADS-B archive; ODbL 1.0.

measurement.target: Directly observed flown mileage from recorded ADS-B ground speed and timestamps
measurement.method: Integrate step-interpolated path_gs values only across accepted contiguous intervals. Coverage is measured against the complete flight start_ts-to-end_ts duration, including missing time before the first and after the last telemetry sample. Do not bridge gaps, expand partial observations, or impute missing speed.
measurement.units: ground speed in knots; elapsed time in seconds; nautical miles converted to kilometres using 1.852
explicitlyNotUsed: API path_length_m as the observed-mileage target
latitude/longitude-derived Earth or route distances as the observed-mileage target
great-circle, spherical, ellipsoidal, or geodesic calculations
scheduled flight times or estimated cruise-speed averages
measurement.trajectoryGeometry: The source API GeoJSON MultiLineString path coordinates and matching timestamps are stored for each accepted flight. Candidate visual calibration projects those recorded points into the custom flat-disk plane and compares the resulting polyline length with the independent ground-speed/time integral. The coordinates are never used to calculate the observed-mileage target.
measurement.airportBoundaryUse: Airport airspace polygons, or a 20 km airport-centred fallback circle, are used only by the source API to identify flights departing and arriving at the selected airports. Airport coordinates are retained as map endpoints. The observed-mileage target is calculated only from recorded ground speed and elapsed time.
